description: Source code for the coroutine library in Lua, implementing coroutine management functions such as create, resume, yield, status, and close.

methods.name: getco
methods.description: Retrieves the coroutine thread from the Lua stack.

methods.name: auxresume
methods.description: Resumes a coroutine with given arguments, handling errors and stack checks.

methods.name: luaB_coresume
methods.description: Lua binding for resume, returns success status and error message.

methods.name: luaB_auxwrap
methods.description: Wraps a coroutine to handle errors during resume and propagate them.

methods.name: luaB_cocreate
methods.description: Creates a new coroutine thread with a given function.

methods.name: luaB_yield
methods.description: Yields execution of the current coroutine.

methods.name: auxstatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a coroutine (running, dead, suspended, normal).

methods.name: luaB_costatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a coroutine as a string.

methods.name: luaB_yieldable
methods.description: Checks if a coroutine is yieldable.

methods.name: luaB_corunning
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the main thread.

methods.name: luaB_close
methods.description: Closes a coroutine if it is dead or yielded.
